scars.title: Concurrent map write in telemetry exporter
scars.lesson: Metrics map must be protected by sync.RWMutex or use sync.Map during concurrent RecordMetric calls.

scars.title: Unclosed HTTP response body leaking sockets
scars.error_signature: net/http: request canceled (too many open files)
scars.lesson: Always defer resp.Body.Close() and io.Copy(io.Discard, resp.Body) before closing.

scars.title: Database connection pool exhaustion on uncommitted transactions
scars.error_signature: pq: sorry, too many clients already
scars.lesson: Every BeginTx must have a deferred tx.Rollback() which is a no-op if tx.Commit() succeeded.

scars.title: ZipSlip path traversal in archive extraction
scars.error_signature: illegal file path in zip archive
scars.lesson: Sanitize zip header name with filepath.Clean and verify strings.HasPrefix(target, destDir).

scars.title: JWT validation missing algorithm enforcement
scars.lesson: Explicitly check jwt.SigningMethodHMAC or RSA in keyfunc, never allow none.

scars.title: Timezone mismatch in billing cycle calculation
scars.error_signature: cycle end must be UTC midnight
scars.lesson: Always call t.UTC() and use time.Date(..., time.UTC) when computing financial cycle boundaries.

scars.title: Default HTTP client missing timeout leading to hung worker
scars.error_signature: context deadline exceeded waiting for worker
scars.lesson: Never use http.DefaultClient without explicit Timeout; instantiate http.Client{Timeout: 30*time.Second}.

scars.title: JSON unmarshaling large integer precision loss
scars.error_signature: int64 id truncated by json float conversion
scars.lesson: Use json.NewDecoder(r).UseNumber() when decoding into map[string]interface{}.

scars.title: Nil pointer dereference on optional proto field
scars.error_signature: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
scars.lesson: Check req.GetProfile() != nil before accessing nested message fields.

scars.title: Goroutine leak on unbuffered channel write during timeout
scars.lesson: Channel used for select timeout result must be buffered with capacity 1 to avoid blocking sender.

scars.title: Redis connection pool timeout under load spikes
scars.lesson: Tune PoolSize and MinIdleConns according to max expected concurrent requests.

scars.title: Silent error ignore in io.Copy buffer drain
scars.lesson: Check error return from io.Copy and verify bytes written matches expected content length.

scars.title: Path traversal in static file server
scars.lesson: Use http.FS and verify path contains no .. segments after Clean.

scars.title: TLS certificate verification accidentally disabled
scars.error_signature: InsecureSkipVerify must not be true in production
scars.lesson: Never set InsecureSkipVerify: true outside testing environments.

scars.title: SQL injection via string concatenation in search query
scars.error_signature: syntax error near unexpected token OR 1=1
scars.lesson: Use parameterized queries ($1, $2) rather than fmt.Sprintf for SQL search clauses.

scars.title: Memory leak from unclosed tar reader in docker builder
scars.error_signature: out of memory while unpacking tar
scars.lesson: Limit total extracted bytes with io.LimitReader to protect against tar bombs.

scars.title: Race condition in atomic counter reset
scars.lesson: Use atomic.StoreInt64 or sync.Mutex when resetting time window and request counters together.

scars.title: YAML parser alias expansion vulnerability (Billion Laughs)
scars.error_signature: yaml entity expansion exceeded memory quota
scars.lesson: Configure yaml decoder with strict node limits or disallow anchor aliasing.

scars.title: Deadlock on nested read locks with pending write lock
scars.error_signature: fatal error: all goroutines are asleep - deadlock!
scars.lesson: Never acquire a RLock while already holding another RLock if a Lock operation can intervene.

scars.title: Context cancellation not propagated to sub-tasks
scars.lesson: Pass ctx to all child goroutines and select on ctx.Done().

scars.title: Log injection with newline splitting in auth logs
scars.error_signature: forged log entry detected via CRLF
scars.lesson: Sanitize newlines and carriage returns from user-controlled fields before writing to log.

scars.title: Re-entrancy bug in payment webhook handler
scars.lesson: Store processed event_id in idempotent ledger with database UNIQUE constraint.

scars.title: Float equality comparison in discount calculator
scars.lesson: Store and compute currency amounts in integer cents or using shopspring/decimal.

scars.title: File permission too open on private key generation
scars.error_signature: private key file must have 0600 permissions
scars.lesson: Write private key files with os.OpenFile using mode 0600, not 0644.

scars.title: Unsorted map iteration causing non-deterministic checksum
scars.error_signature: hash mismatch across identical manifest runs
scars.lesson: Always sort map keys before feeding key-value pairs into sha256.Write.

scars.title: Draft Scar about experimental graphql loader
scars.lesson: Limit max batch keys to 100.

scars.title: Retired Scar about legacy v1 auth cookie
scars.lesson: Cookie v1 was retired in migration 004.

scars.title: DNS resolver timeout under Alpine Linux / musl
scars.lesson: Use CGO_ENABLED=0 with pure Go resolver or set ndots:1 in resolv.conf.

scars.title: Regexp catastrophic backtracking in email validator
scars.lesson: Use standard net/mail ParseAddress or simple character scan instead of complex regex with nested quantifiers.

scars.title: Cross-site request forgery missing header check
scars.lesson: Verify Sec-Fetch-Site and compare Origin header to allowed host before processing state-changing POST.

scars.title: Distractor: General database connection logging
scars.lesson: Keep db logs concise.

scars.title: Distractor: General HTTP request metrics
scars.lesson: Ensure latency metrics use sensible bounds.

scars.title: Distractor: General JSON serializer helper
scars.lesson: Ensure strings are valid utf8 before json encode.

scars.title: Distractor: General token generation helper
scars.lesson: Use crypto/rand for random tokens.

scars.title: Distractor: General cache key formatter
scars.lesson: Sanitize delimiters in redis keys.

scars.title: Distractor: Rate limiter configuration parser
scars.lesson: Parse rates as integer requests per time.Duration.

scars.title: Distractor: Archive tar file header validator
scars.lesson: Skip unsupported PAX headers gracefully.

scars.title: Distractor: Prometheus metrics port binding
scars.lesson: Allow configurable metrics port via env METRICS_PORT.

scars.title: Distractor: Telemetry trace ID generator
scars.lesson: Trace IDs must be 16-byte hex strings.

scars.title: Distractor: Billing currency formatter
scars.lesson: Format currency with locale-specific groupings.

scars.title: Buffer pooling sync.Pool size reset violation
scars.error_signature: buffer returned to pool with dirty content
scars.lesson: Always call buf.Reset() before calling pool.Put(buf) to avoid leaking data.

scars.title: Slice append re-allocation data corruption
scars.error_signature: underlying array overwritten by concurrent append
scars.lesson: Never sub-slice without full 3-index slice s[:len:len] if subsequent append is expected.

scars.title: Unchecked type assertion panic in middleware context
scars.error_signature: interface conversion: interface {} is nil, not *User
scars.lesson: Always use comma-ok idiom `u, ok := ctx.Value(userKey).(*User)` when reading context.

scars.title: Loop variable capture in closure across goroutines
scars.error_signature: duplicate processing of last item in batch
scars.lesson: Explicitly pass item as function argument to goroutine func(item Item) { ... }(item).

scars.title: File descriptor leak in directory walker
scars.error_signature: too many open files during deep directory traversal
scars.lesson: Close directory handles immediately rather than deferring inside a recursive loop.

scars.title: Distractor: Logging colorizer for terminal
scars.lesson: Check term.IsTerminal before emitting ANSI color escape codes.

scars.title: Distractor: Config file environment override
scars.lesson: Parse env string into boolean or integer with validation.

scars.title: Distractor: HTTP router route normalization
scars.lesson: Normalize path once at entrypoint without recursive redirect.

scars.title: Distractor: Health check response handler
scars.lesson: Liveness probe should only check process responsiveness.

scars.title: Distractor: User agent parser for analytics
scars.lesson: Default to Unknown browser for unrecognized UA strings.
